name: Tailwind Donut Progress
css:
.loader { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); border-radius: 9999px; background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color) 0deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 0deg); mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 60%, #000 61%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 60%, #000 61%); animation: twDonut calc(var(--loader-speed) * 2.2) ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes twDonut { 0% { background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color) 0deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 0deg); } 55%, 72% { background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color) 360deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 360deg); } 100% { background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color) 0deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 0deg); } }
tailwind:
{/* keyframes twDonut: interpolate the conic-gradient stop from 0deg to 360deg */}
<span className="inline-block h-16 w-16 animate-[twDonut_2.2s_ease-in-out_infinite] rounded-full [mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent_60%,#000_61%)]" />
